title: High-Throughput RNA Extraction on Agilent Bravo
author: Miriam R Simon
materials: Plate and seal all reagents in the biosafety cabinet on the same day you plan to run the procedure with the following volumes: ReagentVolume per wellQuantityPlateLysis Buffer630 uL11 mL deep-wellMagbeads35 uL1Biorad 96-well PCREthanol900 uL11 mL deep-wellEthanol600 uL41 mL deep-wellRNA Wash 1530 uL11 mL deep-wellRNA Wash 2530 uL11 mL deep-wellPrep Buffer530 uL11 mL deep-wellNuclease-free Water50 uL1Biorad 96-well PCRDNase*60 uL1Biorad 96-well PCRInitial Sample**200 uL12 mL deep-wellElution Plate0 uL1Biorad 96-well PCRWaste0 uL32 mL deep-wellWaste0 uL11 mL deep-well

steps.title: Power on Bravo
steps.instruction: Switch the Bravo instrument on before opening the Bravo software and wait about one minute.

steps.title: Decontaminate decks and cabinet
steps.instruction: Spray the Bravo decks and the biosafety cabinet sequentially with 70 % ethanol, then with RNase‑Zap/Windex, and finally with ethanol again.

steps.title: Load tip boxes
steps.instruction: Retrieve eleven tip boxes and place them on DECK 3 and DECK 9.

steps.title: Load reagents on decks
steps.instruction: Place RNA Lysis Buffer on DECK 1, MagBinding beads on DECK 2, the Sample plate on DECK 5, and a 2 mL Waste plate on DECK 8.

steps.title: Add RNA Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer a total of 600 µL RNA Lysis Buffer to the Sample plate in four 150 µL transfers, then mix and shake the plate on DECK 5 for 5 minutes at 1 rev / min.

steps.title: Replace Lysis Buffer with Ethanol
steps.instruction: Replace the RNA Lysis Buffer reservoir on DECK 1 with 900 µL of Ethanol.

steps.title: Add Ethanol to samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 800 µL Ethanol to the Sample plate in six 133.4 µL transfers, then mix and shake gently on DECK 5 for 5 minutes at half speed.

steps.title: Remove bead plate seal & refresh tips
steps.instruction: Remove the seal from the MagBinding Beads plate, then replace the tip boxes on DECK 3 and DECK 9 with fresh boxes.

steps.title: Add MagBinding beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 30 µL MagBinding beads to the Sample plate, keeping beads in suspension by mixing the bead reservoir before dispensing; then mix and shake gently on DECK 5 for 20 minutes at half speed.

steps.title: Magnetic bead binding
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes until the beads have pelleted.

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant in eleven 145.5 µL transfers.

steps.title: Setup Wash 1 reagents
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate back to DECK 5, replace the MagBinding beads reservoir on DECK 2 with RNA Wash 1, and replace the Waste plate on DECK 8 with an empty 2 mL Waste plate.

steps.title: Add RNA Wash 1
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL RNA Wash 1 to the Sample plate in four 125 µL transfers, then mix and shake on DECK 5 for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic binding after Wash 1
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes until beads pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate Wash 1 supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant in four 125 µL transfers.

steps.title: Setup Wash 2 reagents
steps.instruction: Return the Sample plate to DECK 5, replace RNA Wash 1 on DECK 2 with RNA Wash 2, and replace the tip boxes on DECK 3 and DECK 9 with fresh boxes.

steps.title: Add RNA Wash 2
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL RNA Wash 2 to the Sample plate in four 125 µL transfers, then mix and shake on DECK 5 for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic binding after Wash 2
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes until beads pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate Wash 2 supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant in four 125 µL transfers.

steps.title: Ethanol 1/4 wash
steps.instruction: Replace the Ethanol (900 µL) reservoir on DECK 1 with Ethanol 1/4, then transfer 500 µL to the Sample plate in four 125 µL transfers, and mix and shake on DECK 5 for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic binding after Ethanol 1/4
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes until beads pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate Ethanol 1/4 supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant in four 125 µL transfers.

steps.title: Ethanol 2/4 wash
steps.instruction: Replace Ethanol 1/4 on DECK 1 with Ethanol 2/4, replace tip boxes on DECK 3 and DECK 9 with fresh boxes, transfer 500 µL to the Sample plate in four 125 µL transfers, and mix and shake on DECK 5 for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic binding after Ethanol 2/4
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes until beads pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate Ethanol 2/4 supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant in four 125 µL transfers.

steps.title: DNase treatment
steps.instruction: Replace RNA Wash 2 on DECK 2 with the DNase plate (ensure it is unsealed), replace tip boxes on DECK 3 and DECK 9 with fresh boxes, transfer 50 µL DNase to the Sample plate, and mix and shake gently on DECK 5 for 10 minutes at half speed.

steps.title: Replace DNase with Prep Buffer
steps.instruction: Replace the DNase plate on DECK 2 with a Prep Buffer plate.

steps.title: Add Prep Buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL Prep Buffer to the Sample plate in four 125 µL transfers, then mix and shake on DECK 5 for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic binding after Prep Buffer
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes until beads pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate Prep Buffer supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant in four 137.5 µL transfers.

steps.title: Ethanol 3/4 wash
steps.instruction: Replace Ethanol 2/4 on DECK 1 with Ethanol 3/4, replace tip boxes on DECK 3 and DECK 9 with fresh boxes, transfer 500 µL to the Sample plate in four 125 µL transfers, and mix and shake on DECK 5 for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic binding after Ethanol 3/4
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes until beads pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate Ethanol 3/4 supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant in four 125 µL transfers.

steps.title: Ethanol 4/4 wash
steps.instruction: Replace Ethanol 3/4 on DECK 1 with Ethanol 4/4, replace the Waste plate on DECK 8 with an empty 2 mL Waste plate, transfer 500 µL to the Sample plate in four 125 µL transfers, and mix and shake on DECK 5 for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic binding after Ethanol 4/4
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes until beads pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate Ethanol 4/4 supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the cleared supernatant in four 125 µL transfers.

steps.title: Replace Prep Buffer with Water & dry beads
steps.instruction: Replace the Prep Buffer plate on DECK 2 with a Water plate, confirm the Water plate is unsealed, then dry the beads for 30 minutes or until completely dry.

steps.title: Elution with Water
steps.instruction: Place an Elution PCR plate on DECK 4, move the Sample plate back to DECK 5, replace tip boxes on DECK 3 and DECK 9 with fresh boxes, transfer 45 µL Water to the Sample plate on DECK 5, and mix and shake on DECK 5 for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate on magnetic stand
steps.instruction: Move the Sample plate to the magnetic stand on DECK 7 and incubate for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 40 µL from the Sample plate to the Elution PCR plate on DECK 4.

steps.title: Freeze and discard consumables
steps.instruction: Freeze the Elution PCR plate and the Sample plate at –80 °C, then discard all plates and tip boxes.
